claims.claim: Australia's Federal Court ordered Apple to allow competing app stores, direct downloads, and alternative payments for Australian-region Apple Accounts from noon Melbourne time on March 1, 2027.
claims.episode_span: from noon Melbourne time on March 1, 2027
claims.source_title: Apple Ordered to Open iPhone to Rival App Stores in Australia
claims.supporting_quote: Australia's Federal Court today ordered Apple to allow competing app stores, direct app downloads, and alternative payment services for Australian users from March 1, 2027.

claims.claim: The orders follow an August 2025 finding that Apple misused its market power.
claims.episode_span: The orders follow the court's August 2025 finding that Apple misused its market power
claims.source_title: Apple Ordered to Open iPhone to Rival App Stores in Australia
claims.supporting_quote: The orders follow the court's August 2025 finding that Apple misused its market power by restricting app distribution and payment options.

claims.claim: Apple told Reuters it plans to appeal and seek a pause, citing intellectual property and App Store security, and may apply between February 1 and February 15 for an extension until May 3.
claims.episode_span: Apple told Reuters it plans to appeal and to ask the court to pause enforcement
claims.source_title: Apple Ordered to Open iPhone to Rival App Stores in Australia
claims.supporting_quote: Apple told Reuters that it plans to appeal the ruling and ask the court to pause its enforcement, citing its intellectual property rights and App Store security.

claims.claim: Epic Games told Reuters Fortnite returns to Australia's App Store today; Australia was the only country excluded when Fortnite returned worldwide in May.
claims.episode_span: Fortnite returns to Australia's App Store today
claims.source_title: Fortnite Returning to Australian App Store After Court Ruling
claims.supporting_quote: Fortnite will return to Australia's App Store today, Epic Games told Reuters, after a federal court ordered Apple to allow eligible Epic apps back onto the store.

claims.claim: Meta reported Q3 revenue of $64.60 billion, up 26%, September family DAP of 3.64 billion, up 3%, ad impressions up 10%, and average price per ad up 14%.
claims.episode_span: third-quarter revenue of $64.60 billion, up 26% year over year
claims.source_title: Meta Stock Rebounds and Retreats as Meta Platforms Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Expectations
claims.supporting_quote: Revenue was $64.60 billion, an increase of 26% year-over-year on both a reported and constant currency basis.

claims.claim: Meta's Q3 costs were $51.61 billion, including a $9.89 billion charge related to an agreement with 52 attorneys general providing payments of up to about $18.59 billion.
claims.episode_span: a $9.89 billion charge tied to an August agreement with 52 attorneys general
claims.source_title: Meta Stock Rebounds and Retreats as Meta Platforms Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Expectations
claims.supporting_quote: In August 2026, we announced an agreement with 52 attorneys general to resolve litigation related to teen mental health and social media, which provides for payments of up to approximately $18.59 billion.

claims.claim: Meta narrowed 2026 capital expenditures to $135-145 billion from $130-145 billion and guided Q4 revenue to $73-76 billion.
claims.episode_span: 2026 capital expenditure is now guided to $135-145 billion, narrowed from $130-145 billion
claims.source_title: Meta Stock Rebounds and Retreats as Meta Platforms Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Expectations
claims.supporting_quote: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $135-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $130-145 billion.

claims.claim: FXLeaders reports a $25 billion New Mexico penalty against Meta for misleading data privacy practices.
claims.episode_span: a $25 billion New Mexico penalty over misleading data-privacy practices
claims.source_title: Meta Stock Rebounds and Retreats as Meta Platforms Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Expectations
claims.supporting_quote: A $25 billion penalty from New Mexico for misleading data privacy practices adds pressure on Meta, alongside rising computing costs and competition from OpenAI.

claims.claim: Meta announced a new class of nonvoting stock that could help pay for acquisitions and other expenses.
claims.episode_span: a new class of nonvoting stock that could help pay for acquisitions
claims.source_title: Meta Gains on Results, New Stock Class to Fund AI
claims.supporting_quote: The company boosted its capital spending plans for the year and announced a new class of nonvoting stock that could ultimately be used to help pay for acquisitions and other expenses.

claims.claim: DigiTimes reported iPhone Duo orders rising about 44% from 9.7 million to 14 million units over 12 months.
claims.episode_span: lift iPhone Duo output by roughly 44%, from 9.7 million to 14 million units
claims.source_title: Apple Reportedly Boosts iPhone Duo Orders by 44%
claims.supporting_quote: Supply chain sources said Foxconn and component manufacturers had received instructions reflecting a roughly 44% increase from 9.7 million to 14 million devices.

claims.claim: Education Times reports Cognizant assigned 18,000 engineers to Google Gemini AI.
claims.episode_span: Cognizant has assigned 18,000 engineers to Google's Gemini AI
claims.source_title: Cognizant assigns 18,000 engineers to Google Gemini AI
claims.supporting_quote: Cognizant assigns 18,000 engineers to Google Gemini AI: What they will build and how it will help businesses

claims.claim: MegazoneCloud won an AWS GovCloud resale nod and is targeting U.S. public and defense customers.
claims.episode_span: MegazoneCloud has won a resale authorization for AWS GovCloud
claims.source_title: MegazoneCloud wins AWS GovCloud resale nod, targets U.S. public, defense
claims.supporting_quote: MegazoneCloud wins AWS GovCloud resale nod, targets U.S. public, defense

claims.claim: NVIDIA expanded Cosmos with training tools, simulation checkpoints, and Data Factory blueprints, and says it ranks top five on six open-model leaderboards.
claims.episode_span: ranks in the top five on six different open-model leaderboards
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
claims.supporting_quote: Ranking top five on six different open models leaderboards, the NVIDIA Cosmos platform gives world model builders the frontier open

claims.claim: Google Maps on CarPlay now has Gemini voice controls, live first in the US, via a new icon during navigation.
claims.episode_span: Google put Gemini's voice inside Google Maps on CarPlay
claims.source_title: Google Maps Adds Gemini Voice Controls For Apple CarPlay Users
claims.supporting_quote: At the moment, the update is live for drivers in the US.

claims.claim: Jensen Huang told Nscale to work around the clock after setbacks bringing some data centers online.
claims.source_title: Nvidia’s Huang Urged Nscale to Move Faster After Early Setbacks
claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said he told UK-based neocloud Nscale to “work around the clock” to overcome challenges in bringing some of its data centers online.

claims.claim: HomeView tabletop and wall models each cost 299 in the United States and launch November 13.
claims.episode_span: each priced at 299 in the United States, launch on November 13
claims.source_title: Simplicity and Siri AI Are HomeView's Killer Features, Apple Says
claims.supporting_quote: The tabletop and wall-mounted models each cost 299 in the United States and launch on November 13.
